question: What was a unique feature of Harappan town planning?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Grid pattern streets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Harappan Civilization**, also known as the **Indus Valley Civilization**, is renowned for its advanced urban planning and architectural design.
 
• One of the most unique and distinguishing features of Harappan town planning was the use of a **grid pattern** for streets.
